name: Conservation, Food & Health Foundation grants
summary: Seed grants for applied research, pilot projects and training in conservation, food and health in Africa, Asia, the Caribbean, Latin America and the Middle East (not post-Soviet or Balkan states), with a short concept application twice a year before invited proposals.

geography.label: Africa, Asia, the Caribbean, Latin America, and the Middle East

amount.note: No minimum or maximum; most grants fall in this range

reporting: Grantees submit a final report; multi-year grantees also submit an interim progress report, an interim financial report and a second-year work plan before the end of the first grant period.

eligibility.rule: Applicant is not a government department, except a public university or research center.
Applicant is not an unregistered charity or NGO pending registration.
Applicant is not a business, B-Corp, co-op, private limited company, or social enterprise without charitable status.
Organisation has experience and accomplishments beyond a limited track record.
Project is not based in a post-Soviet or Balkan state.
Project is not a microenterprise, ecotourism, or livelihood project.
Project does not request buildings, water systems, pumps, wells, or large equipment purchases.
Grant request does not exceed 25% of the organisation's total operating budget.

calls.label: Concept applications, twice a year
calls.recurring: 15 October to 22 December, and 1 May to 15 June

status.quote: The concept application (or LOI) is open two times per year: October 15 - December 22 May 1 - June 15

recurring.quote: The concept application (or LOI) is open two times per year: October 15 - December 22 May 1 - June 15

administered_by.quote: c/o Prentice A. Zinn, Administrator GMA Foundations 2 Liberty Square, Suite 500 Boston, Massachusetts 02109

applicant_types.quote: Most organizations that can provide evidence of their non-governmental status or charitable purpose are eligible to apply, including non-governmental organizations, nonprofit organizations, civil society organizations, community-based organizations, and colleges, universities, and other academic institutions.

geography.quote: The Foundation supports local, state, and regional organizations in Africa, Asia, the Caribbean, Latin America, and the Middle East, where the projects are based.

amount.quote: There is no minimum or maximum grant size. It is anticipated that most grants will fall in the $25,000-$50,000 per year range.

access.quote: The foundation has an online, two-phase application system comprised of a short concept application, followed by a limited number of invited full proposals.

window.quote: The concept application (or LOI) is open two times per year

reporting.quote: Interim progress reports, interim financial reports and second-year work plans for multi-year grants are due 30 days before the end of the recipient's first grant period.

effort.quote: Submit your online concept application between October 15 and December 22 or between May 1 and June 15.
followed by a limited number of invited full proposals.

eligibility.quote: Government departments, except public universities and research centers.
Unregistered charities or NGOs pending registration
Businesses, B-Corps, Co-ops, Private Limited Companies Social enterprises without charitable status
The Foundation does not fund organizations with limited experience and accomplishments, even if they use a well-established organization as a fiscal agent.
It does not support projects in post-Soviet states or Balkan states.
Microenterprise, ecotourism, and livelihood projects: The Foundation does not fund these economic development projects.
The Foundation does not fund buildings, water systems, pumps, wells, or large equipment purchases.
The foundation does not makes grant that exceed 25% of an organization's total operating budget.

after_award.quote: Submit an interim report with any request for follow-up support. Submit a final report at the end of the grant period or project phase.
